task_title: Absorb trigger: board-event watcher with persisted cursor + Auger DuckBrain adapter, proposal-only
task_criteria: FAILIF: the trigger re-reads already-seen board events after restart or writes a runbook without operator approval; PROOF: uv run pytest tests/ -q (572 passed) including test_cursor_resume_falsifier_fails_without_persistence (memory-only cursor mutation replays events) and test_board_event_trail_flows_to_proposal_without_runbook_write (no runbook-tree writes), plus uv run lore validate exit 0

items.criterion: FAILIF: the trigger re-reads already-seen board events after restart or writes a runbook without operator approval; PROOF: uv run pytest tests/ -q (572 passed) including test_cursor_resume_falsifier_fails_without_persistence (memory-only cursor mutation replays events) and test_board_event_trail_flows_to_proposal_without_runbook_write (no runbook-tree writes), plus uv run lore validate exit 0
items.detail: Cursor resume: lore/trigger.py:88-113 consume() seeks to the persisted offset, refuses a cursor past EOF (lines 96-99), and calls cursor_store.set(board, end) only after the whole suffix parsed (line 112); JsonCursorStore persists per-board offsets atomically via os.replace (lore/trigger.py:33,58-65). Run: `uv run pytest tests/ -q` -> "572 passed in 4.73s", exit 0; `uv run pytest tests/test_lore071_trigger.py -v` -> all 6 PASSED including test_cursor_resume_falsifier_fails_without_persistence and test_board_event_trail_flows_to_proposal_without_runbook_write. The falsifier (tests/test_lore071_trigger.py:57-76) now injects MemoryOnlyCursor directly -> replays 3 blocks, then the persisted JsonCursorStore -> 0 blocks, so the mutation is live (the HEAD commit 0e662b1 removed the dead monkeypatch). No runbook write: the only write path in lore/trigger.py is the cursor file (lines 60-65); absorb_sweep is data-only (lore/absorb.py:353-411, docstring 'PROPOSE-NOT-WRITE'); tests/test_lore071_trigger.py:118-130 asserts the runbook tree still contains only the operator-owned marker. `uv run lore validate` -> exit 0. Also `uv run ruff check .` -> "All checks passed!" and `bash scripts/check-test-count.sh` -> "PASS: test-count guard: canonical=572 matches live=572".

items.criterion: The cursor is only advanced after the whole suffix parses successfully, so a malformed/partial trailing board line does not silently skip events on the next run (no event loss / no silent advance).
items.detail: lore/trigger.py:104-107 raises ValueError on a bad line before the set() at line 112. Ad-hoc run against a board with a truncated trailing line: "raised: ValueError invalid board event at byte 190" and "cursor after failure: False"; after completing the line the next consume returned ['board:A', 'board:B'] — no event lost, no silent advance.

items.criterion: The persisted cursor is keyed per board path and survives a fresh process (new store instance reading the same file), so two different boards do not clobber each other's offsets.
items.detail: JsonCursorStore keys by str(board.resolve()) (lore/trigger.py:33,58) and merges the existing payload (lines 47-58). Ad-hoc run with two boards sharing one cursor file: b1 first ['board:X1'], b2 first ['board:Y1'], b1 second [] and the cursor file held both keys {"/tmp/l71/b1.jsonl":142,"/tmp/l71/b2.jsonl":142}. Cross-instance persistence is exercised by tests/test_lore071_trigger.py:51-54, which constructs a new JsonCursorStore(cursor) per call.

items.criterion: The trigger layer is reachable from a documented entrypoint (docs/README) and the documented usage snippet actually runs against the shipped API (no invented symbols/arguments).
items.detail: docs/ABSORB-TRIGGER.md:38-50 snippet (BoardEventWatcher + JsonCursorStore + absorb_sweep(source="board-event")) was executed verbatim in an ad-hoc script -> "snippet ok, proposals: 2 board-event"; README.md:467 links docs/ABSORB-TRIGGER.md. No CLI subcommand wires the watcher (`uv run lore --help` lists match/consult/compile/validate/gate/absorb/show/audit), but the doc states at lines 52-55 that no timer or service is installed and the owner runs it from a separately managed process, so the documented entrypoint is the Python API and it works.

items.criterion: The Auger adapter is read-only: reading an export performs no writes to the export file, the DuckBrain store, or any runbook tree.
items.detail: AugerDecisionTableAdapter.read() only calls self.export.read_text (lore/trigger.py:218-220); parse_auger_export is pure string parsing (lines 160-215). grep for write_text/open(...,'w')/mkdir/os.replace/shutil across lore/trigger.py, lore/absorb.py and lore/runbook.py returns only the cursor-store writes at lore/trigger.py:60-65. tests/test_lore071_trigger.py:104-116 snapshots tmp_path before/after the adapter read and asserts equality.

cd /tmp && rm -rf l71 && mkdir l71 && cd l71 && cat > t.py <<'EOF'
import json, sys
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0, "/home/kara/get-h3/lore")
from lore.trigger import BoardEventWatcher, JsonCursorStore
from lore.absorb import absorb_sweep

d = Path("/tmp/l71")
# 1) partial trailing line: valid event + truncated JSON (no newline)
board = d/"b.jsonl"
board.write_text(json.dumps({"event_type":"task_completed","task_id":"A","detail":json.dumps({"class_id":"gateway-drain-window","lesson":"drain before restart"})})+"\n"+'{"event_type":"task_completed","task_id":"B","det', encoding="utf-8")
cur = d/"c.json"
try:
    BoardEventWatcher(board, JsonCursorStore(cur)).consume()
    print("NO ERROR on truncated line")
except Exception as e:
    print("raised:", type(e).__name__, e)
print("cursor after failure:", cur.exists() and cur.read_text().strip())
# complete the line, re-run
with board.open("a", encoding="utf-8") as h:
    h.write('ail":"{}"}\n')
blocks = BoardEventWatcher(board, JsonCursorStore(cur)).consume()
print("after completion, blocks:", [b.source for b in blocks])

# 2) two boards, one cursor file
b1 = d/"b1.jsonl"; b2 = d/"b2.jsonl"
line = lambda tid: json.dumps({"event_type":"task_completed","task_id":tid,"detail":json.dumps({"class_id":"gateway-drain-window","lesson":"drain before restart"})})+"\n"
b1.write_text(line("X1")); b2.write_text(line("Y1"))
c2 = d/"c2.json"
print("b1 first:", [b.source for b in BoardEventWatcher(b1, JsonCursorStore(c2)).consume()])
print("b2 first:", [b.source for b in BoardEventWatcher(b2, JsonCursorStore(c2)).consume()])
print("b1 second (should be []):", [b.source for b in BoardEventWatcher(b1, JsonCursorStore(c2)).consume()])
print("cursor file:", c2.read_text().strip())

# 3) documented snippet
from lore.trigger import AugerDecisionTableAdapter
blocks = BoardEventWatcher(board, JsonCursorStore(d/"c3.json")).consume()
props = absorb_sweep(blocks, source="board-event")
print("snippet ok, proposals:", len(props), props[0]["provenance"]["source"] if props else None)
